raw_segments.text: They sat side by side, both mournful and dejected, as though they had been cast up by the tempest
He looked at Sonya and felt how great was her love for him, and strange to say he felt
it suddenly burdensome and painful to be so loved.
Yes, it was a strange and awful sensation.
On his way to see Sonya, he had felt that all his hopes rested on her.
He expected to be rid of at least part of his suffering, and now, when all her heart
turned towards him, he suddenly felt that he was immeasurably unhappier than before.
